review_notes: I read the whole file: sphereCone_injOn, sphereCone_image, sphere_toSphere_local and sphere_induced_volume. The local volume lemma is a change of variables calculation. The last theorem applies uniqueness of the volume measure. I found no non-trivial reasoning repeated between two proofs in this file. I grepped the repo for the main tools used here, lintegral_abs_det_fderiv_eq_addHaar_image and toSphere_apply'. The other uses are in different settings: Falconer and Boltzmann sphere-isometry invariance, and other change-of-variables sites. None of them repeats this file's chart-cone derivation. I did not read all of them in detail, so some uncertainty remains about similar blocks elsewhere. The repeated toSphere_apply' rewriting is a short routine step. The 3 * ofReal(1/3) = 1 calculation is short and appears only once.
